svg.title: FARSPACE full technology tree map
svg.desc: Scrollable map of all 60 implemented FARSPACE technologies arranged by domain and era. Solid lines show each domain's progression sequence. Nodes labeled HOOK mark future-hook technologies already visible in research roadmap.

g.text: All 60 implemented technologies. Scroll page viewport to inspect full layout. Source: docs/design/tech-tree.md.
Layout groups techs by domain and era. Solid lines show per-domain progression order. HOOK marks future-facing unlocks already exposed in tree.
